name: get_neon_auth_config
description: Read Neon Auth config for a branch with OAuth and SMTP secrets redacted as "***redacted***". Requires provision_neon_auth first.

branch_id.description: Branch ID. If omitted, the project default branch is used (same as provision_neon_auth).

project_id.description: Neon project ID. Required for an unscoped connection. May be omitted when the connection is scoped to one project; if provided, it must match that project.
